##### Project general facts

Verdes by Haven is an apartment collection within the first wellness-inspired community in the city, created by Aldar to bring health, comfort and nature into everyday life. The development is made up of residential buildings ranging from four to seventeen storeys, with selected buildings including a podium, and an iconic Treehouse at the entrance built around a majestic tree. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments and two-bedroom duplexes, finished in light and dark schemes with natural tones.

Amenities are designed around wellbeing. The multi-level Treehouse houses a community lounge, a co-working lounge and the Treehouse Cafe, while residents can enjoy an infinity swimming pool and a kids' pool, a round-the-clock gym, a spin room and spa treatment rooms. A central park with water streams, outdoor fitness areas, jogging and cycling tracks, yoga and meditation pavilions, a multi-sports court, shaded play areas and a multipurpose room complete the offer, alongside a nursery, a clinic, a mosque and a retail centre.

Apartments offer elegant interiors and thoughtful layouts, with spacious living and dining areas, walk-in closets, powder rooms and laundry areas, while duplexes add a dedicated kids' play area. Sustainability features include an optimised HVAC system, photovoltaic systems, water conservation and smart waste management, helping reduce utility bills. Services include housekeeping, lifestyle and travel concierge, free yoga and Pilates, home maintenance and babysitting. Homes are delivered unfurnished, leaving furniture and decoration to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubailand is home to well-established premium communities such as Villanova, Arabian Ranches and Al Barari, offering a calm sanctuary away from the bustle of the city. Wadi Al Safa combines landscaped neighbourhoods, schools, nurseries and everyday retail with easy access to the city's major roads, while Al Habtoor Polo Club and Global Village are close by for leisure and entertainment.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Emirates Road and Al Ain Road connect residents with the wider city. Global Village is a short drive away, while Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance, and Dubai Marina can be reached easily for weekend leisure, dining and beach outings, while schools, clinics and supermarkets serve families across the surrounding communities.

Dubailand is a freehold area with strong demand from families and professionals seeking space, greenery and accessible entry points compared with central districts. Wellness-led communities with certified sustainable design are in limited supply, supporting steady rental demand and occupancy. The backing of a leading developer and the established reputation of the surrounding communities underpin long-term value for owners and investors.
